preregistered_constants.depth_supervision_c_r: (R - r) / R for r < R; c(R) = 0

validate_command: PYTHONPATH=$PWD/src python -c "import json; from slm_training.autoresearch.experiment_campaign import ExperimentCampaignV1, CampaignLockV1, campaign_manifest_sha256; d=json.load(open('src/slm_training/resources/experiments/recursive_adaptive_depth_h7/campaign.v1.json')); m=ExperimentCampaignV1.model_validate(d['manifest']); assert campaign_manifest_sha256(m)==d['manifest_sha256']; CampaignLockV1(manifest_sha256=d['manifest_sha256'], manifest=m); print('ok', d['manifest_sha256'])"

manifest.hypothesis: H7: hiding the recursion index from the shared recursive denoiser and decaying per-depth supervision to zero at the final depth (an EqM-style c(R)->0 analogue) yields per-depth CE that never regresses at any depth, and decode-time halting on y_update_state_ratio < tau then reaches the fixed-R endpoint quality in fewer recursion steps and less wall clock.
manifest.decision: recursive_adaptive_depth_positive iff, for a candidate arm, the Wilson 95% lower bound of the per-seed adjacent-depth CE non-regression pass rate clears 0.5 (SLM-421 protocol), no depth shows paired CE regression vs fixed_r_control beyond 1e-3, halting fires on >0% and halts at depth 1 on <=50% of inputs, and every kill criterion stays untripped; recursive_adaptive_depth_negative iff any kill criterion trips or the Wilson upper bound falls below 0.5; otherwise inconclusive_underpowered. Fixture-only diagnostic; never a ship, checkpoint, or default claim.

endpoints.metric: recurrence_health.per_seed_pass_rate[CE(r+1) <= CE(r) + 1e-3 for every r < R_eff and every fixture example]
max over r in 1..4 of mean paired (CE_candidate(r) - CE_fixed_r_control(r)) over seeds x examples
mean paired (CE_candidate(R_eff) - CE_fixed_r_control(R=4)) over seeds x examples; R_eff is the halted depth for the halting arm
mean halted depth R_eff over seeds x examples (fixed arms report R_max=4); full per-input distribution is a required artifact
fraction of seeds x examples where halting fired at r < R_max
fraction of seeds x examples where halting fired at r = 1
measured wall-clock seconds per seed for all three arms (train + one diagnostics forward + halting decode)

stopping_rules: Stop after all 3 arms x 20 seeds (22..41) finish; a run that exceeds MAX_RUN_MINUTES=3 wall (src/slm_training/levers.py) is aborted and is never evidence.

PRECONDITION fixture_headroom: do not start any seed until the eval fixture manifest records >=1 eval example on which ar_only is invalid; as of 2026-09-02 no such example exists, so the campaign status is blocked_on_fixture_headroom and execution is refused.
No outcome is read before the CampaignLockV1 digest of this manifest is recorded; any post-lock edit is a CampaignDeviationV1 (exploratory).

controls.description: Positive matched control: fixed_r_control shares d_model=32, layers, tokenizer, fixture records, optimizer and R=4 with both candidates; levers.require_size_matched_arms must pass for every candidate (halting and supervision schedules add zero parameters).

Destructive negative control: the halting arm re-decoded with tau=+inf must halt at r=1 on 100% of inputs, reproduce the control's depth-1 CE bit-for-bit, and trip the halt_at_depth_1_majority kill; otherwise the halting rule or the kill criterion is not live and the campaign is void.

Quality control: fixed_r_control on seeds 22..41 must satisfy the SLM-421 recurrence-health condition at a pass rate whose Wilson 95% interval overlaps SLM-421's [0.699, 0.972]; otherwise the fixture is broken and no candidate comparison counts.

PRECONDITION (blocks execution; status=blocked_on_fixture_headroom): the eval fixture must contain >=1 eval example on which ar_only is invalid. As of 2026-09-02 none exists: the SLM-138 fixture (_fixture_records) is two train-split records a/b with no ar_only arm, and the SLM-155 eval decision corpus is ar_only hard-valid on 40/40 (SLM-434). A successor fixture with recorded headroom must be registered and this control re-locked before any seed runs.

manifest.author: S9
executable_kill_criteria: kill:any_depth_ce_regression -- as SLM-282 (seed 1, R=4, example b, CE 17.487688 -> 17.855324): per arm, if the Wilson 95% upper bound of the per-seed adjacent-depth non-regression pass rate falls below 0.5 the arm is killed (recursive_adaptive_depth_negative).
kill:per_depth_ce_regression_vs_control -- any depth r in 1..4 with mean paired CE_candidate(r) - CE_fixed_r_control(r) > 1e-3 kills that candidate.
kill:halting_never_triggers -- index_hidden_halting_tau with halt_trigger_fraction == 0 over 20 seeds x 2 examples is killed (tau=0.30 unreachable).
kill:halt_at_depth_1_majority -- index_hidden_halting_tau with halt_at_depth_1_fraction > 0.5 is killed (tau=0.30 too permissive).
kill:size_mismatch -- levers.require_size_matched_arms fails for any candidate vs fixed_r_control; capacity is never bought with parameters.
kill:fixture_headroom_missing -- the run's fixture manifest records no eval example on which ar_only is invalid: refuse to start.
